# A reply lists a question's own line as an instruction printed inside its item

Unedited live replies of the one-family-per-batch run d26-real-1fam-low-16 on
svenska_2_grammatik_omprov_variant_1_med_facit. The grouping gives q2 body:0016 and body:0017 as
its own chunks. Reply `docx_w2-01-01` lists body:0017, "Skriv NF, PF eller VF.", only in
`instructions`, and its converted item lists body:0016 and body:0018 to body:0022.
